info.title: BidiLint — lint localization files for bidi (bidirectional text) pitfalls.
info.description: Lint RTL localization files with a Unicode 17 UAX #9 bidi engine: missing keys, unisolated Latin runs, mixed numerals, unbalanced isolates, presentation forms, and Trojan Source controls. Supports JSON, .resx, Android, Apple .strings, gettext, and Flutter ARB, with config, reasoned suppressions, baselines, and CI thresholds.

options.name: --base
options.description: Base culture other cultures are compared against (default: en).

options.name: --max-warnings
options.description: Fail when the warning count exceeds n.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Print only errors in text output.

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable color; NO_COLOR is also honored.

options.name: --no-config
options.description: Ignore config discovery and use defaults.

options.name: --init
options.description: Write a documented bidilint.json starter file.

options.name: --baseline
options.description: Apply a baseline of accepted findings.

options.name: --update-baseline
options.description: Rewrite the baseline from current findings.

options.name: --debug
options.description: Print config details and full exceptions.
